facts.text: Antares Descent Stage was deployed at Fra Mauro during Apollo 14 in 1971.
Lower half of Lunar Module Antares. After a tense manual landing following a computer abort signal, Shepard and Mitchell touched down at Fra Mauro — the original target for the ill-fated Apollo 13.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Validated improved landing radar and abort guidance systems developed after the Apollo 13 incident, enabling future missions to target more challenging terrain.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Fra Mauro.
Remains at Fra Mauro; its ascent stage was deliberately crashed into the Moon, creating a known-energy seismic source for the ALSEP network.
